description: Find haunted houses, haunt farms, ghost tours, horror escape rooms and haunted places within a radius of a latitude/longitude, nearest first. Call this when the user gives a place, address or coordinates and wants scary things to do nearby. Geocode a place name to lat/lng first; this tool does not search by name. Filter by category, by season, or by minimum visitor ratings. Unrated haunts (review_count 0) have null ratings and are left out when min_stars or min_scare is set. For a whole city or state use scaremap_find_haunts_in_city. For the full record and reviews of one result use scaremap_get_haunt.

category.description: Only this category. Call scaremap_categories for the list.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, decimal degrees.

lng.description: Longitude of the search center, decimal degrees.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles. Default 25, maximum 150.

season.description: halloween = seasonal haunt, year_round = open outside October.

name: scaremap_find_haunts

total_matches.description: Matches inside the radius before the limit is applied.

title: Find haunts near a location
